fixed_statistics.truth_path: eligible exact-family path matching all four canonical-float active bins
fixed_statistics.truth_score: maximum injected score among complete truth paths
fixed_statistics.rank_min: 1 plus count of eligible hypotheses with score strictly greater than truth_score
fixed_statistics.rank_max: count of eligible hypotheses with score greater than or equal to truth_score

interpretation: This is a post-data diagnostic of previously exposed conditional injections, not fresh validation.
Ranks span correlated paths and overlapping windows; they are not independent trials or a false-alarm calibration.
The delta-bin residual injection does not model the instrumental line-spread function or raw preprocessing.
Any retained-candidate policy inferred from these outcomes is DEVELOPMENT ONLY and must be frozen before fresh validation.
